A '''diamond hoe''' is a [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, crafted from two [[diamond]]s and two sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Farming and mining ===
It breaks hoe blocks at speed 9 and has 2500 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 4.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades. With a template it becomes an [[Electrum Mattock|electrum]] or [[adamant mattock]].
